name: Infra (Saudi National Infrastructure Fund)
rationale: Saudi government development-finance vehicle (operates under the National Development Fund, distinct legal entity from PIF) running a dedicated 'AI Data Center Financing Program.' Signed its first transactions under that program on 2026-11-08: two financing facilities totaling SAR2.5bn (~$667M) with PIF-owned HUMAIN, for GPU procurement and power/grid infrastructure. Builds on a Jan 2026 Davos framework of up to SAR4.5bn ($1.2bn). Worth tracking as a recurring sovereign AI-infrastructure lender alongside PIF/HUMAIN, not folded into PIF since Infra is the capital-deploying entity of record.
